messages:
alex: quick follow-up from the allocator-arch sync — I want to propose a lightweight "lease packing" optimization to reduce fragmentation when many small leases are hot simultaneously.
debra: can you sketch what packing looks like at the shim level versus allocator level?
alex: two approaches: 1) shim-level packer: group adjacent small leases into a meta-lease and pin a single backing slab. cheaper allocator-side changes but more shim bookkeeping. 2) allocator coalescer: allocator merges adjacent allocations lazily when pressure low; simpler shim.
nate: shim packer implies we need a canonicalization map (meta->children) and safe release semantics. tricky for partial evictions.
li: partial evicts are the sticky part. if allocator evicts a page from the packed slab, how do we report per-lease residency? we could expose a per-lease residency bitmap or use a best-effort score.
alex: prefer best-effort score for v1: `probe_residency(lease_id) -> {score:0..1, last_epoch}`. cheap probabilistic counting (bloom-ish) to avoid per-page maps.
deebra: agree on pragmatic v1. we should also avoid introducing new hard guarantees. callers must design for demotes.
ops-bot: note created: ticket INF-2123 (lease-packing POC), add to sprint backlog.
nate: operational signals we need: packed_lease_alloc, packed_lease_split, packed_lease_evicted, packed_lease_partial_eviction. Also per-tenant pack efficiency metric (bytes_saved_by_packing).
li: and add `lease_group_id` in the metadata so logs correlate which leases were grouped.
alex: runtime API sketch:
```
lease = lease_client.acquire(tenant='search', size=1MB, hint='hot', packable=True)
if lease.group_id:
  # multiple logical leases share group
  monitor_group(lease.group_id)
score = lease_client.probe_residency(lease.id)
```
debra: important: packable flag must be advisory. allocator may decline packing and return reason codes like `NOT_ENOUGH_HOLE` or `FRAGMENTED`. record those as `pack_decline_reason`.
nate: about backfill and repairs: when group gets partial evicted we should try async backfill for high-priority groups. implement backfill worker that operates with `lease_priority` threshold.
li: that needs throttles so backfill doesn't starve other work. add `backfill_budget` token bucket per-rack.
deebra: rollout plan: 1) implement probe_residency probabilistic API + metrics; 2) shim-level packer POC with passthrough fallback; 3) canary on low-traffic tenant; 4) iterate on allocator coalescer if POC shows gains.
alex: testing matrix: latency SLO under bursty small-lease workloads, fragmentation measured via usable-runway metric, backfill CPU usage, and per-tenant fairness.
nate: small UX note: expose `pack_hint` to callers so they can say if their object tolerates partial eviction (e.g., cache vs model KV).
li: security note: keep lease group metadata unprivileged in logs; avoid leaking tenant ids across multi-tenant dashboards. use hashed tenant tags.
ops-bot: reminder: add alert rule if `packed_lease_partial_eviction` spikes >5% in 5m. :bell:
alex: ok I'll draft the RFC addendum with the API sketches and tests. tagging @ops-bot for the alert. thanks all.
